Blue Whale needs a simple interface to test conversation drift detection and recovery [2].

- Interface: A terminal application for the MVP [1]. A web interface is deferred [1]. An explicit user-approved change supersedes the corresponding earlier decision [3]. Changes introduced only by the AI are treated as potential conversation drift [3].
